notes: Interface implemented by ConfigVarProgress, FileExistsCondition, MapArchiveSource, SpriteLoadValidator (all in jvmMain). Every implementation returns 100 when the underlying resource (js5 archive entry / config var) is present/fully loaded, otherwise a 0-100 completion percentage. Each impl also computes an unused decoy expression from the param (e.g. `88 % ((-43 - i) / 62)`, `-62 / ((i - -43) / 62)`) whose result is discarded - classic opaque-predicate filler. Call sites (BinaryGraphicsOptionState.kt) pass unrelated magic ints (28, 87, i.toInt() xor 0x75), reinforcing that the param is not semantically load-relevant.

Every implementation returns one of a small set of singleton CollisionFlagQuery constants (one per concrete class) identifying which condition type produced it. SlotBinding.method2025 always calls it with the fixed constant -15004 and asserts (`require`) the result equals an expected constant by reference identity - i.e. it's used as a type tag/kind check, not a real data getter. Implementations also gate decoy field-clearing side effects on `i != -15004`, which is dead at the one real call site since -15004 is always passed.
